entities.text:
High Court Of Andhra Pradesh
 At Amaravati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The Court made the following order:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners herein/A4 & A5 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.523 of 2022 on the file of learned II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Palamaner, for the offences under Sections 498A read with Section 34 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission to withdraw the Criminal Petition on the ground that the matter involved in this petition is settled out of the Court.
3. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the State is in attendance.
4. Permission is accorded.
